title: The New Kid
about: Arriving as the quiet newcomer and gradually finding a place by helping wherever I was needed.
description: This track captures what it felt like to enter State Arts-In without knowing anyone. I spent the first days watching, listening, and learning before slowly becoming part of the tech crew. Every small opportunity to help built confidence, turning a quiet observer into someone the team could rely on. It's about how belonging often begins with simple acts of service rather than big moments.
lyrics: I stood near the edge of every room,
Trying not to take up too much space.
To know every hallway, joke and face.
But every time they said, "Come help,"
I stepped deeper in the frame.
I knew how to work, I knew how to learn,
I just didn't know when to speak.
So I waited for somebody to point,
Then carried whatever they needed from me.
But every time they said, "Come help,"
I stepped deeper in the frame.
The techies moved where no one looked.
No grand entrance, no shining cue,
Just a job that needed to be took.
But every time they said, "Come help,"
I stepped deeper in the frame.
I finished one thing, went looking for more,
So I walked to Greg and asked what he had,
Then asked if I could help him with it.

I stepped deeper in the frame.
